queries_run: Eaton data center 800 VDC solid-state transformer disruption threat 2026

findings.claim: Eaton 10-K 風險因子自述：其產品所服務的資料中心等市場曾出現並可能持續出現突發的破壞性技術，可能衝擊終端市場；且新進入者可能影響其地位。
findings.excerpt: Our products and services support innovative technology and mega trends, including, for example, data centers. These markets have experienced and may continue to experience the abrupt introduction of disruptive technologies, which may, in turn, negatively impact our end markets.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅見 Eaton 自身推 SST/800VDC（Infineon 合作、Resilient Power 收購）及 Siemens/Reinhausen、Sungrow 等競品 SST；未找到把替代技術框為 Eaton 威脅的來源。僅取得搜尋摘要，無逐字原文，列為 clues。

clues.claim: Siemens 與 Reinhausen 開發中壓固態變壓器供 800V DC AI 資料中心；Sungrow 2026-07 推出 800V DC SST（競爭者進入同一替代架構）
clues.source: Bayern Innovativ: New Transformer for Data Centers

clues.claim: Eaton 2025-08 以 8600 萬美元收購 SST 開發商 Resilient Power Systems，CEO 稱 AC 轉 DC 遷移為真
clues.source: Utility Dive: Eaton CEO AC-to-DC migration
